name: Saba the Divine
description: A serene healer who draws power from the deep, mending wounds and warding her companions with divine light.
lore: Once a temple guardian of the sunlit shallows, Saba followed whispers of a divine light into the deep. Where others see darkness, she sees purpose — and her faithful terrier Winnie never leaves her side.
mechanics: Winnie alternates between two support abilities each turn: Divine Mend heals your party, and Guardian's Ward grants protective shields. This alternating rhythm makes Saba's runs more forgiving but slower than Andy's aggressive approach.
